descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Who we are: 
 Open-minded intellectuals who embrace emerging technologies on our mission to create innovative Software Engineering Solutions that will impact millions of users around the world . 
 We are looking for: 
 We are looking for a Data Scientist to contribute to the development of our analytical platform, supporting the maintenance and continuous improvement of AI models across our Open Banking businesses in six European markets: France, Germany, Spain, Italy, Portugal, and Belgium. In this role, you will leverage data analysis and visualization techniques to address business challenges across different markets, translate business needs into effective data science approaches, and develop data-driven solutions that support business objectives.
 What you will do: 
Analyze and explore data
Produce and optimize data analytics models/tools;
Together with the development team you will ensure high-level of scalability for our engines and ensure code optimization (RAM, cores, any IT resource) to have light engines;
Run python-based analytical engines on a regular basis (monthly, weekly, daily) to serve countries and automate these run phases;
Ensure that the code of their models is well documented, ready for production and can easily be maintained; • Ensure interpretability of the models they develop,
Identify potential bias and analyze model performance with regards to the business needs.
Mentor Junior members;
 What you must have: 
Education: Degree in Information Technology, Computer Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field.
Experience: At least 3 years of relevant experience in a similar role, with a proven track record of success.
Strong programming and scripting skills (Python), academic knowledge about machine learning, statistical analysis (AB testing, significance tests, among others) and quantitative analysis skills
Knowledge of development pipelines (git, CI/CD) and agile tools (Jira), databases (relational and graph - vertica, oracle, SQL server), experience with ETL, knowledge of BI/visualization tools (Tableau Software, PowerBI)
Good skills in collaboration, communication, adaptability and initiative spirit, high focus on delivery, with detail-oriented mindset
Fluency in English – another European language is a plus
 What's in it for you: 
Extended compensation and benefits package
Continuous learning opportunities to enhance your professional and soft skills
A great working environment with people who put their heart, mind, and soul into everything they do and understand the importance of team spirit
 We really welcome open-minded and commited people: 
Eager to take on new challenges and learn new things
Who put their heart, mind, and soul into everything they do
Who enjoy sharing knowledge and understand the importance of team spirit.
 ***Only eligible candidates will be contacted to move forward in the recruitment process.
